\textbf{Statement on independence and data:} The author is employed at a
financial institution. This work was carried out outside that
employment, through the author's own practice, Generatywnie; it does not
represent the views of the employer and uses no data, processes, systems
or other resources of the employer. All environments are synthetic; the
counterparty-verification policy paraphrases only public legal texts.

\textbf{Code and data availability:} Generator code, intervention
catalogue, baseline implementations, analysis scripts, run logs, the
author's review files and the reading notes are released under open
licences (Apache-2.0 for code, CC BY 4.0 for texts and data). Every
episode, including the held-out and shifted splits, is regenerated
deterministically from its seed, and all seeds are published with the
code; a private seed range is reserved for the second phase. The
repository is https://github.com/speplinski/worktrace (release v1.0);
the results files the paper cites are in its \texttt{paper/pilot/}
directory, and every file path in this paper is relative to its root;
\texttt{results\_interim.md} reports all data and
\texttt{results\_core.md} the common core.

\textbf{Use of AI assistance:} This paper was prepared with substantial
help from an AI system, Claude (Anthropic), used through the Claude Code
agent environment. Its role was as follows. (1) \emph{Literature.} It
searched arXiv and the web, read papers and wrote structured reading
notes, which are published in the repository; every reference was then
checked against arXiv or Crossref metadata where available and otherwise
against the publisher's or issuer's page, and the bibliography records
how each entry was checked. (2) \emph{Study design.} It proposed and
critiqued design options. The author made every design decision and
approved the pre-registration and each amendment; the decision log is
published. (3) \emph{Code.} The generator, the oracles, the agent
harnesses, the LLM judge and the analysis scripts were written by the AI
system at the author's direction and reviewed and run by the author. (4)
\emph{Writing.} The text was drafted by the AI system from the author's
theses, decisions and results; the author revised and approved it and
takes responsibility for every claim. The experiments were run by the
author on his own computer and API account. \emph{Potential conflict of
interest.} The AI system used for this work is developed by Anthropic,
whose models are among the configurations evaluated, and an Anthropic
model serves as the LLM judge for the two judge-based baselines and for
the judge and declared-grounds tests, with a second judge from another
developer run as a check (amendment A10). To limit the resulting risk,
the study was pre-registered before data collection; ground truth comes
from two deterministic oracles, not from any model; configurations from
seven other developers are included; the judge's rubric, its one
